The 4H stays bullish and the 1H trend is still up, but the combined signal holds at HOLD, keeping this a breakout trigger and not an aligned trend trade. Bias remains constructively long but trigger-gated: entry 4,207.48, stop 4,198.93, target 4,348.43, with invalidation on a break below the stop that opens the 4,140.87–4,141.58 gap as the next structural defense.

The short from 1.39 is invalidated: price reclaimed the 1.39 lower pivot and is holding at 1.40, with the 1H trend now up and the combined 4H+1H read flipped to HOLD. That is exactly the invalidation condition from the prior read — a reclaim of 1.39 that holds — so the bearish 4H continuation is on hold, not dead, since the 4H direction itself remains bearish. The open-FVG list is still empty, so there is no fresh imbalance to trade against. Bias is neutral between 1.39 and 1.53; a sustained break above 1.53 restores the bullish regime, while losing 1.39 again re-arms the 1.25 target.
